objectives: To expand knowledge on active faults topics, to acquire the ability to critically read and understand a scientific article and to develop presentation skills.
content: Study and present scientific articles in the field of active fault studies (earthquake geology, paleo- seismology, present-day crustal deformation, tectonic geomorphology, structural geology, regional tectonics, earthquake hazard, fault-displacement hazard…)
grading_policy: “Article report and understanding (40％), slides design and presentation skills (30％), discussion (20％), overall participation in the class (10％)“

distribution_conditions.rule: 系所:限應用地質研究所碩士班、應用地質研究所博士班。
